user.title: Ddareungi setup
user.description:
Sign in with your Ddareungi account to use the unofficial API.

- **Username/Password**: Used to log in
- **My location entity (optional)**: Reference point for nearby recommendations
- When re-authenticating with the same username, leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

abort.reauth_failed: The entry to re-authenticate was not found.
